## Summary

Hardens ADR 0156 campaign evidence identity so automatic recording requires the frozen benchmark schema, corpus, benchmark/runtime harness, exact model representation, hardware, quality, workload policy/workload, task-specific tool/permission budget, completion criteria, and an untagged source record before campaign execution identity is attached.

Campaign resume identity now covers task runtime harnesses, workloads, tool budgets, comparison/profile/environment, sampling and seed policy. Machine-local campaign progress also uses a rollback-safe replacement path so repeated saves work on Windows rather than relying on rename-over-existing semantics.

## Validation

Windows Validation is requested by the trusted dispatcher. AI Studio campaign launcher/progress/report integration and required Editor Visual Validation follow after this core gate is green.
